fusions.name: Arcane Injunction
fusions.desc: A bolt of force that deals 12 damage, rising to 1.4 times that at its full reach of 7 tiles, with a 40% chance to leave the target [Suppressed] for 3 seconds. Your afflictions on the target spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Candles Bow
fusions.desc: Raises the rod and deals 30 damage to every enemy within 4 tiles, ignoring their resistances.

fusions.name: Countermand
fusions.desc: For 6 seconds, each spell aimed at you has a 40% chance to be turned back on whoever cast it.

fusions.name: Held in Reserve
fusions.desc: When your mana is full, your next spell deals 25% more damage. Once every 10 seconds.
